verdict.rationale: The only direct multi-item evidence is the Crash Reporting export, which can export all error groups or a selected set from the dashboard, plus CSV exports that follow the applied filters. Rule-based ignore conditions hint at handling many errors at once, but nothing documents bulk resolve, ignore or assign actions across selected error groups. Nothing shows bulk operations driven through the API or the MCP server either. Missing for 10: documented bulk status changes or assignment across many error groups, bulk operations via API or the MCP server for agent-driven workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
